healthcheck.title: Healthcheck
healthcheck.description: Validate the Breezy HR API token.

user.get.title: Get current user
user.get.description: Retrieve the authenticated Breezy HR user.

companies.list.title: List companies
companies.list.description: List companies available to the account.

companies.get.title: Get company
companies.get.description: Retrieve one Breezy HR company by ID.

departments.list.title: List departments
departments.list.description: List department definitions for a Breezy HR company.

positions.list.title: List positions
positions.list.description: List positions for a Breezy HR company, optionally filtered by lifecycle state.

positions.get.title: Get position
positions.get.description: Retrieve one Breezy HR position by company and position ID.

positions.create.title: Create position
positions.create.description: Create a Breezy HR position. name, type, description, and location country are required.

positions.update.title: Update position
positions.update.description: Partially update a Breezy HR position.

candidates.list.title: List candidates
candidates.list.description: List candidates on a Breezy HR position, optionally filtered by stage.

candidates.get.title: Get candidate
candidates.get.description: Retrieve one Breezy HR candidate on a position.

candidates.create.title: Create candidate
candidates.create.description: Add a candidate to a Breezy HR position.

candidates.update.title: Update candidate
candidates.update.description: Partially update a Breezy HR candidate on a position.

candidates.search.title: Search candidates by email
candidates.search.description: Find company-wide Breezy HR candidates whose email matches exactly.

pipelines.list.title: List pipelines
pipelines.list.description: List hiring pipelines for a Breezy HR company.

team.list.title: List position team
team.list.description: List team members assigned to a Breezy HR position.

user.details.title: Get user details
user.details.description: Retrieve the authenticated user's companies and account details keyed by friendly ID.

pipelines.get.title: Get pipeline
pipelines.get.description: Retrieve one Breezy HR hiring pipeline with its ordered stages.

questionnaires.get.title: Get questionnaire
questionnaires.get.description: Retrieve one Breezy HR questionnaire definition.

questionnaires.list.title: List questionnaires
questionnaires.list.description: List the questionnaires defined for a Breezy HR company.

templates.get.title: Get template
templates.get.description: Retrieve one Breezy HR message template.

templates.list.title: List templates
templates.list.description: List the message templates defined for a Breezy HR company.

candidates.assessments.list.title: List candidate assessments
candidates.assessments.list.description: List the assessments stored on a Breezy HR candidate.

candidates.backgroundChecks.list.title: List candidate background checks
candidates.backgroundChecks.list.description: List the background check results recorded on a Breezy HR candidate.

candidates.conversation.list.title: List candidate conversation
candidates.conversation.list.description: List the email thread messages exchanged with a Breezy HR candidate.

candidates.customAttributes.list.title: List candidate custom attributes
candidates.customAttributes.list.description: List the company's candidate custom attribute definitions.

candidates.customFields.list.title: List candidate custom fields
candidates.customFields.list.description: List the custom field values stored on a Breezy HR candidate.

candidates.documents.list.title: List candidate documents
candidates.documents.list.description: List the documents attached to a Breezy HR candidate.

candidates.meta.get.title: Get candidate meta
candidates.meta.get.description: Retrieve the aggregated task, document, scorecard, questionnaire, stream, and conversation bundle for a candidate.

candidates.questionnaires.list.title: List candidate questionnaires
candidates.questionnaires.list.description: List the questionnaire responses recorded on a Breezy HR candidate.

candidates.stream.list.title: List candidate stream activity
candidates.stream.list.description: List the stream activity recorded on a Breezy HR candidate, optionally skipping earlier entries.

positions.customAttributes.list.title: List position custom attributes
positions.customAttributes.list.description: List the company's position custom attribute definitions.

positions.customFields.list.title: List position custom fields
positions.customFields.list.description: List the custom field values stored on a Breezy HR position.

webhooks.get.title: Get webhook endpoint
webhooks.get.description: Retrieve one Breezy HR webhook endpoint by ID.

webhooks.list.title: List webhook endpoints
webhooks.list.description: List the webhook endpoints registered for a Breezy HR company with quota metadata.

candidates.customAttribute.update.title: Set candidate custom attribute
candidates.customAttribute.update.description: Set or replace one custom attribute value on a Breezy HR candidate.

candidates.education.update.title: Update candidate education
candidates.education.update.description: Add or update one education entry on a Breezy HR candidate.

candidates.notes.create.title: Add candidate note
candidates.notes.create.description: Post a note to a Breezy HR candidate's activity stream.

candidates.workHistory.update.title: Update candidate work history
candidates.workHistory.update.description: Add or update one work history entry on a Breezy HR candidate.

candidates.documents.create.title: Add candidate document
candidates.documents.create.description: Attach a document to a Breezy HR candidate. The runner sends the file bytes as a raw application/octet-stream request body; Breezy documents this endpoint as multipart/form-data with field document.

candidates.createFromResume.title: Create candidate from resume
candidates.createFromResume.description: Upload a resume, parse it, and create a candidate on a Breezy HR position. The runner sends the file bytes as a raw application/octet-stream request body; Breezy documents this endpoint as multipart/form-data with field resume.

webhooks.create.title: Create webhook endpoint
webhooks.create.description: Register a webhook endpoint for a Breezy HR company. The signing secret is returned only on creation.

webhooks.update.title: Update webhook endpoint
webhooks.update.description: Update the URL, events, description, or enabled flag of a Breezy HR webhook endpoint.

webhooks.delete.title: Delete webhook endpoint
webhooks.delete.description: Delete a Breezy HR webhook endpoint and stop its deliveries.

webhooks.pause.title: Pause webhook endpoint
webhooks.pause.description: Pause deliveries for a Breezy HR webhook endpoint without deleting it.

webhooks.resume.title: Resume webhook endpoint
webhooks.resume.description: Resume deliveries for a paused Breezy HR webhook endpoint.
